slides.hook: every arm exercise in my programme

slides.name: Preacher Curl
slides.text: the pad stops you swinging. control it all the way down.

slides.name: Bayesian or Hammer Curl
slides.text: bayesian: cable behind you, arm stretched back. hammer: neutral grip, no swinging.

slides.name: Poliquin Pushdown
slides.text: elbows pinned to your sides. squeeze at the bottom.

slides.name: Triceps Extension
slides.text: let the weight stretch your triceps at the bottom, then press up.

slides.title: where they go in my week
slides.note: 2 working sets each. no arm day.

slides.label: real tip (don't skip this)
slides.text: write down every working set. beating last time by one rep is how you know you've improved.
slides.footer: this is the app i'm building for it. it's called EARND.
